title: Oozy Sweet Persian Pistachio Dumplings
description: A sweet and molten post-workout Polish dish featuring ground pistachios, perfect for a dessert or snack. The dumplings are made with raw-friendly ingredients and have a delicious oozy center.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground pistachios, honey, coconut milk, shredded coconut, vanilla extract, and lemon zest, and mix until well combined.
Add the arrowroot powder to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of coconut oil.
Add the dumplings to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are lightly browned.
Serve the dumplings warm, with a drizzle of honey and a sprinkle of shredded coconut.
To make the dumplings oozy, serve with a side of warm honey and let each person drizzle it over their dumpling.
Let the dumplings cool for a few minutes before serving, to allow the centers to set.
